name: Jac
caption: Your social status will never set you free. Your self-worth will.

slides.text:
Your social status will never set you free.

Your self-worth will.

(7 truths the black sheep learned)

1. Status is what they see. Worth is what you ARE.

Status can be bought, borrowed, or lost overnight.

Your worth was yours before you owned anything.

2. Character always shows

You can see it in how someone carries themselves, how they stand, how they make decisions when nobody is clapping.

That's worth. And it can't be faked for long.

3. Status keeps you performing

Every title, every flex, every follower count needs to be maintained.

That's not freedom. That's a job you never applied for.

4. Worth lets you walk away

From the wrong job. The wrong people. The wrong room.

Someone who knows their worth can't be BOUGHT.

5. The answers are inside, not up the ladder

Climbing higher won't fix what you haven't faced within.

Look INWARD first.

6. Self-worth makes decisions simple

When you truly respect yourself, you stop saying yes to what drains you.

No debate. No guilt.

7. Freedom starts when you stop needing to be seen

The herd chases status.

The black sheep builds WORTH.

Stop asking how you look to them.

Start asking who you are when nobody's watching.

That's what sets you free.
